A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same EXCEEDS/SciEvents research work, with complete main text and Appendices A–J. Text comparison and rendering of all 26 pages establish that the content matches apart from the first-page arXiv version/date stamp.

before.justification: v2 reports original SciEvents experiments, including model comparisons and ablations in Tables 3–4, error analyses in Figures 4–5, and detailed results in Appendix E.

after.justification: v3 retains the original SciEvents experiments, ablations, error analyses, and Appendix E results. These reported experimental outcomes qualify even though they are unchanged from v2.

M1.justification: Section 5 and Appendix A retain identical contextual encoding, word-word grid construction, grid refinement, training loss, and event-decoding procedures.

E1.justification: Both use the same SciEvents collection of ACL abstracts and the same event-detection, argument-extraction, and sub-event tasks. Coverage of discontinuous, overlapping, reverse-order, and hierarchical structures is unchanged.

E2.justification: Comparator membership matches within corresponding experiments in Tables 3–4 and 20–22. The evaluated baselines remain OneIE, ScentedEAE, EEQA, PAIE, Tagprime, DEEIA, BartGen, DEGREE, and KnowCoder.

E3.justification: The 80%/10%/10% split, five evaluation metrics, predicted-trigger protocol, backbone choices, training settings, and architecture-specific evaluation adaptations are identical in Section 6.1 and Appendices B–C.

E4.justification: The contextual-encoding and grid-refiner ablations, complex-structure evaluations, identification and classification error analyses, and appendix dataset-distribution analyses are unchanged.

E5.justification: Both specify three independent runs in Section 6.1 and retain the same average-score and accompanying ± reporting in Tables 3–4 and 20–22. No statistical reporting procedure is added or revised.

E6.justification: All reported numerical entries and graphical findings match, including appendix results. For example, EXCEEDS retains AC F1 of 43.20±0.29 and EC F1 of 48.25±0.10 in Table 3 and the corresponding appendix tables.

T1.justification: The event definitions, grid and loss equations, and computational complexity and memory analysis in Appendix D are identical.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same SciEvents dataset contribution, EXCEEDS framework contribution, and claims about scientific-text complexity and state-of-the-art performance.

C2.justification: Interpretations of model performance and error mechanisms are unchanged. Both retain the limitations concerning abstract-only data, excluded multimodal information, and restricted coverage of the NLP domain.

D1.justification: Implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware, computational costs, annotation procedures, remuneration, and code/data access information are unchanged. The changed arXiv self-link only identifies the later paper version.

R1.justification: Section 2, citations throughout the paper, and the reference list are identical. Positioning relative to existing datasets and extraction methods is unchanged.

P1.justification: The first-page arXiv stamp changes from v2 dated 24 Apr 2026 to v3 dated 9 Jun 2026. All other wording, terminology, headings, and document organization remain identical.

P2.justification: Figures 1–11, Tables 1–25, Algorithm 1, captions, and placement are unchanged. Rendered comparisons show identical page layouts and visual content apart from the stamp text covered under P1.

improvement.justification: The scientific content, experimental evidence, explanations, reproducibility information, limitations, and appendix material are identical. Updating the arXiv version/date stamp and its self-link produces no meaningful difference in overall paper quality.
